info.name: Workday Integration Workday Absence Management Absence Types Pay Groups API
info.description:
API for managing employee leave requests, absence types, and time-off balances. Retrieves eligible absence types for employees and supports validation of leave category selections.

Contact Support:
 Name: Workday API Support
 Email: api-support@workday.com
